<r>2 Mac 7:10-12</r>

<h>Martyrologium</h>
<c>Q</c>uinto Kaléndas Novémbris Luna vicésima octáva. Anno Dómini 2027
<h>I</h>n Pérside natális beatórum Apostolórum Simónis Chananǽi, et Thaddǽi, qui et Iudas dícitur. Ex ipsis autem Simon in Ægýpto, Thaddǽus in Mesopotámia Evangélium prædicávit; deínde, in Pérsidem simul ingréssi, ibi, cum innúmeram gentis illíus multitúdinem Christo subdidíssent, martýrium consummárunt.
<h>R</h>omæ sanctórum Mártyrum Anastásiæ senióris Vírginis, et Cyrílli. Ipsa Virgo, in persecutióne Valeriáni, sub Probo Præfécto, vínculis constrícta, cólaphis cæsa, igne et verbéribus est cruciáta, et, cum in confessióne Christi permanéret immóbilis, tandem, abscíssis mamíllis, evúlsis únguibus, déntibus comminútis, mánibus pedibúsque præcísis, truncáta cápite, tot passiónum ornáta monílibus migrávit ad Sponsum; Cyríllus autem, ei peténti aquam propínans, martýrium pro mercéde accépit.
<h>I</h>tem Romæ sanctæ Cyríllæ Vírginis, quæ fília éxstitit sanctæ Tryphóniæ, et, sub Cláudio Príncipe, pro Christo iuguláta est.
<h>A</h>pud Comum sancti Fidélis Mártyris, sub Maximiáno Imperatóre.
<h>M</h>ogúntiæ sancti Ferrútii Mártyris.
<h>M</h>eldis, in Gállia, sancti Farónis, Epíscopi et Confessóris.
<h>V</h>ercéllis sancti Honoráti Epíscopi.
<r>℣.</r> Et álibi aliórum plurimórum sanctórum Mártyrum et Confessórum, atque sanctárum Vírginum.
<r>℟.</r> Deo grátias.
b.01c22d0caa:
<h>Martyrology</h>
<c>O</c>ctober 28th 2027, the 28th day of the Moon, were born into the better life:
<h>T</h>he blessed Apostles Simon the Canaanite and Thaddeus, who also is called Jude. Simon preached the Gospel in Egypt, and Thaddeus in Mesopotamia, afterward they both came into Persia, and when they had brought into the obedience of Christ a countless multitude of that people, they finished their course by martyrdom.
<h>L</h>ikewise at Rome, in the persecution under the Emperor Valerian, the holy martyrs the Virgin Anastasia the elder and Cyril. Anastasia was thrown into chains under the Prefect Probus, buffeted, and tormented with fire and stripes, and, forasmuch as she remained unshaken in confessing Christ, her breasts were cut off, her nails torn out, her teeth broken, and her hands and feet, and lastly her head, cut off; and gloriously prepared by all these sufferings she passed away as a bride adorned for her husband. As for Cyril, when Anastasia asked for a drink of water, he gave it to her, and for this he was rewarded by suffering death as a martyr.
<h>A</h>t Rome, the holy Virgin Cyrilla, daughter of holy Tryphonia. She was killed for Christ's sake, under the Emperor Claudius.
<h>A</h>t Como, under the Emperor Maximian, the holy martyr Faithful.
<h>A</h>t Mainz, the holy martyr Ferrutius.
<h>A</h>t Meaux, (toward the end of the seventh century,) the holy Confessor Faro, Bishop (of that see.)
<h>A</h>t Vercelli, (at the beginning of the fifth century,) holy Honoratus, Bishop (of that see.)
<r>℣.</r> And elsewhere many other holy martyrs, confessors, and holy virgins.
<r>℟.</r> Thanks be to God.
